updates.content:
Title: Admins may see Copilot usage report delays in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see Copilot usage report delays in the Microsoft 365 admin center. 

Current status: We identified an upstream data dependency issue that is causing processing delays with Copilot usage reports. We're working on a fix to address the source of the upstream issue and will ensure that the Copilot usage report data becomes up to date.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any admins in the North America and Asia-Pacific regions viewing Copilot usage report data in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Friday, September 18, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: An upstream data dependency is causing processing delays with Copilot usage reports. 

Next update by: Friday, September 18, 2026, at 8:00 PM UTC
